user.title: Anycubic Photon printer
user.description: How should Home Assistant reach the printer?

menu_options.local: Local network (LAN) – fastest, no account needed
menu_options.cloud: Anycubic Cloud – works even when the printer's IP changes

local.title: Local network
local.description: Enter the printer's IP address. You can find it on the printer under Settings → Network.

cloud.title: Anycubic Cloud
cloud.description:
Recommended: **Slicer Next token**. Sign in to Anycubic Slicer Next on Windows, close it, open `%AppData%\AnycubicSlicerNext\AnycubicSlicerNext.conf` in Notepad and copy the value of `access_token` (about 344 characters, without quotes).

Alternative: **Web token**. Sign in at cloud-universe.anycubic.com, open the browser console (F12) and run `window.localStorage['XX-Token']`. Web tokens expire, and you'll be asked for a new one when that happens.

reauth_confirm.title: Anycubic Cloud sign-in expired
reauth_confirm.description: Anycubic Cloud no longer accepts the saved token. Paste a new one (see the setup instructions for where to find it).

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the printer. Check that it is on, connected to Wi-Fi, and that the IP address is correct.
error.invalid_response: The printer answered, but not with the expected LAN protocol.
error.invalid_auth: Anycubic Cloud rejected the token. Check that you copied all of it, without quotes.
error.cloud_unreachable: Could not reach Anycubic Cloud. Try again in a moment.
error.no_printers: No printers are linked to this Anycubic account. Add the printer in the Anycubic app first.
error.printer_missing: That token belongs to an account without this printer.

abort.reauth_successful: Signed in again. The printer will reconnect.
